title: Inefficient slice growth
summary: Appending many items without preallocating capacity when size is known or bounded.
rationale: Slice growth can repeatedly allocate and copy backing arrays.

detection.notes: Detect make([]T, 0) followed by append loops where length is known.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use make([]T, 0, n) or make([]T, n) and assign by index when appropriate.
remediation.tradeoffs: Overestimating capacity can retain memory longer than needed.

pattern.title: Inefficient slice growth
